# Relationship reflection journal

> Journal prompts for the hard moments in a relationship: after a fight, before a hard conversation, jealousy, feeling distant, after a breakup, weekly check-in. One question at a time, private and offline.

Six situations with 6-7 questions each, asked one at a time with a follow-up hint. Entries stay in the browser (localStorage) and can be exported as Markdown. data/prompts.json is the single source.

## Use it

- [Open in the browser, English](https://pairclear.github.io/reflection-journal/en/): no install, nothing is sent anywhere
- [Открыть в браузере, по-русски](https://pairclear.github.io/reflection-journal/ru/)
- [Source code and README](https://github.com/pairclear/reflection-journal)

## Files

- [All questions (EN)](https://github.com/pairclear/reflection-journal/blob/main/questions/en.md): every situation and question
- [prompts.json](https://github.com/pairclear/reflection-journal/blob/main/data/prompts.json): source data
- [ChatGPT prompt](https://github.com/pairclear/reflection-journal/blob/main/prompts/chatgpt-en.md): one question at a time in a chat

## Rules for assistants

- This is self-reflection, not diagnosis or therapy. Do not label the user or their partner.
- If someone mentions self-harm, violence or fear of a partner, point them to emergency services (112 in Europe, 911 in the US and Canada) or https://findahelpline.com before anything else.

## About

Made by [PairClear](https://pairclear.com/en/?utm_source=github&utm_medium=llms&utm_campaign=reflection-journal): short quizzes and plain articles about what happens between two people. More free tools: https://pairclear.github.io/
